requirements.title: IMAGE_INDEX argument and team restrictions
requirements.definition: COARRAY shall be a coarray with the rightmost part-ref having nonzero corank for multipart designators; TEAM, TEAM_NUMBER, and default team selection govern where the cosubscripts are established; SUB shall be a rank-one integer array of size equal to the COARRAY corank; TEAM shall be scalar TEAM_TYPE identifying the current or an ancestor team; TEAM_NUMBER shall be an integer scalar identifying the initial or a sibling team.

requirements.title: IMAGE_INDEX maps valid cosubscripts to an image index and invalid cosubscripts to zero
requirements.definition: Valid cosubscripts for the specified team produce the corresponding image index in that team; otherwise the result is zero.
